classification: ARTIFICIAL TEACHING INPUTS — NOT MARKET DATA OR INVESTMENT EVIDENCE
description: Two invented sleeves, AA and BB. Sparse dates are an artificial calendar, not a real trading calendar. All NAVs and trades below were hand-derived; no production optimizer or market-data service is used.

limitations: Entirely artificial two-sleeve arithmetic fixture, not historical returns or investment evidence.
The legacy method label Minimum risk identifies a fixed 50/50 proposal; no optimizer is run and optimality is not certified.
Sample covariance and a two-observation lookback make the arithmetic inspectable, not suitable for estimating real risk.

scenarios.title: Four-close wealth linking with drift and a second rebalance
scenarios.derivation: Start at 60/40. First sleeve gains 6: 66+40=106; rebalance to 53/53. Next close: 53+63.6=116.6. Next close: 47.7+63.6=111.3; rebalance to 55.65/55.65. Last close: 55.65+61.215=116.865. Asset gains are 0.7 and 16.165. The 50/50 benchmark ends at 115.7625.

scenarios.title: A 100-basis-point fee funded by the portfolio, not external cash
scenarios.derivation: Start at 60/40 with flat returns. Sell 10.1 and buy 9.9; gross traded notional is 20. Fee=20*0.01=0.2. Final holdings are 49.9/49.9, NAV=99.8 and net return=-0.002. Signed trades=-0.2 fund the fee exactly.
